messages.Nie ma jeszcze zapisanych gier. Partie z: No saved games yet. Games are saved automatically when they end, and during a game you can save a moment with “★ Save moment”.
messages.Brak zapisanych momentów. Wybierz ruch i: No saved moments. Pick a move and click “★ Save this moment”.
messages.Uwaga trafi do „Moich zapisanych gier” w: The note goes to the selected players' “My saved games”, with the position from this move.
messages.Zapisane gry wymagają konta — zaloguj si: Saved games need an account — sign in again.
A coach note can't be edited.
messages.Ten gracz nie ma konta — uwaga nie ma gd: This player has no account — the note has nowhere to go.
messages.zegary ruszą po pierwszych ruchach obu s: clocks start after both sides have moved
messages.Jeszcze przed pierwszymi ruchami. Jeśli: Before the first moves. If they don't come back, the game will be aborted and won't count.
messages.Przed pierwszymi ruchami nie można ogłos: You can't claim a result before the first moves — the game will be aborted if your opponent doesn't return.

plurals.Uwaga trafiła do {n} gracza.|Uwaga trafi: The note reached {n} player.|The note reached {n} players.

patterns: ^Za dużo nieudanych prób\. Spróbuj za (.+?) min\.$
Too many failed attempts. Try again in $1 min.
^Zdecyduj, co z klubem „(.+?)”: usunąć go albo przekazać komuś\.$
Decide what happens to the club “$1”: delete it or transfer it to someone.
You can send at most $1 invites per day.
^Nie ma klubu o takim kodzie albo hasło jest złe\. Pozostało prób: (\d+)\.$
No club with that code, or the password is wrong. Attempts left: $1.
^Nie ma klubu o takim kodzie albo hasło jest złe\. Dołączanie zostało czasowo zablokowane\.$
No club with that code, or the password is wrong. Joining is temporarily blocked.
^Za dużo błędnych kodów\. Dołączanie do klubów zablokowane do (.+)\.$
Too many wrong codes. Joining clubs is blocked until $1.
^Dołączanie do klubów jest zablokowane na stałe po wielu błędnych kodach\.$
Joining clubs is permanently blocked after many wrong codes.
^Przy jednej partii można zapisać najwyżej (.+?) momentów.$
You can save at most $1 moments per game.

speech.takeback-done: Move taken back. Put the pieces back.
speech.takeback-declined: Your opponent declined the takeback. The game goes on.
